identity_rule: This receipt identifies the tested source bytes below, built after the task base. Commit metadata and documentation-only edits do not replace those byte identities. Referenced build receipts retain their original run status and identity.

profile.model_weight_quantization: IQ4_NL model weights; native A quantized dispatch
profile.chat_profile: assistant-eot; explicit DAG; native EOG required
profile.publication: Exactly one BODY input token per running insertion point per cohort. Freeze committed peer prefixes, include own current token only, synchronize every accepted native call, then publish the whole cohort. Next cohort sees new peer tokens.
profile.frame: One query per sequence per native call in waves; all waves use one frozen peer world and publish once.
profile.submission_provider: One opaque native A context submission domain, using per-call TQRelay run_submissions(call, 1); no invented per-device completions.
profile.recurrent_storage: Logical sequence namespace separate from a bounded physical recurrent pool. Sealed workers retire recurrent state without deleting resident attention KV.
profile.release_support: CPU and the executed one-GPU Vulkan none/layer configurations. F16, quantized KV, unavailable providers, and unqualified devices are not implied.

reproducibility.memory_scope: compute_release before/after are llama_memory_compute_bytes values; not model weights, KV usage, or peak GPU-memory measurements.
